QUOTE: "If there is no section at all, `whole_repo_scope` applies (`scope.py:683`). Its single root is the repo" and "a repository's own declaration decides the index scope if it has one. If it doesn't, clew indexes the whole repository"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says a declared `index_scope` decides when present and that an absent declaration falls through to whole-repo indexing, with the reason logged. It also says a malformed declaration is refused rather than falling back, but that is a different case from failing to find one.
